title: Sources: Trump administration officials have told CAISI to halt publication of its model assessments while an EO President Trump signed last week is implemented (Amrith Ramkumar/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Amrith Ramkumar / Wall Street Journal: Sources: Trump administration officials have told CAISI to halt publication of its model assessments while an EO President Trump signed last week is implemented — Unit's future was thrown into doubt after its public work was halted despite winning praise from AI developers
